scope: Public product context and recommended analyst research outputs; no new service is represented as already delivered.

sources.title: Health-system collaboration
sources.fact: Quest describes CoLab solutions spanning laboratory management, supply-chain partnership and laboratory analytics.

sources.title: Comprehensive analytics
sources.fact: Quest Comprehensive Insights combines core laboratory, Quest and third-party testing data to examine testing patterns and utilization.

sources.title: Reference-testing insights
sources.fact: Quest Essential Insights provides analytics focused on Quest reference testing for reference-testing customers.

sources.title: Ordering and results workflows
sources.fact: Quanum Lab Services Manager supports tasks including ordering tests, tracking orders, requesting supplies and accessing results.

strategy.title: Compare partnership value propositions
strategy.question: Which health-system needs best support a collaboration proposition?
strategy.output: A comparison brief linking partnership models to customer needs and existing PMR themes.
strategy.validation: Validate decision criteria with the health-system research evidence; identify unsupported claims.

strategy.title: Assess analytics positioning
strategy.question: How do data coverage and perceived value influence differentiation?
strategy.output: A positioning matrix comparing reference-testing insights and broader analytics propositions.
strategy.validation: Check perceived value against Data Ecosystem Needs and Extended findings before recommending messages.

strategy.title: Prioritize growth hypotheses
strategy.question: Which consumer and enterprise opportunities have enough evidence for a decision brief?
strategy.output: A ranked opportunity brief with supporting evidence, uncertainties and next research questions.
strategy.validation: Separate established findings from hypotheses and validate gaps through approved research.

maci.title: Build customer needs by segment
maci.question: How do unmet needs differ across health-system and consumer audiences?
maci.output: A needs-and-persona matrix supported by survey patterns and expert themes.
maci.validation: Keep individual study bases visible; use qualitative evidence to explain patterns, not infer prevalence.

maci.title: Trace journey friction
maci.question: Where do users encounter friction in ordering, tracking and finding results?
maci.output: A research-based journey map with pain points, evidence references and follow-up questions.
maci.validation: Triangulate Digital Customer Journey findings with Voice of Experts before prioritizing issues.

maci.title: Test value and messaging hypotheses
maci.question: Which analytics benefits resonate with each customer segment?
maci.output: A message-hypothesis brief and recommended discussion-guide or survey questions.
maci.validation: Use existing evidence to frame hypotheses; run approved customer validation before claiming effectiveness.

operations.title: Translate research into requirements
operations.question: Which workflow and data needs should inform product discussions?
operations.output: A customer-derived requirements matrix with evidence, priority rationale and unresolved questions.
operations.validation: Review feasibility with Quest product and operations stakeholders before treating any item as a roadmap commitment.

operations.title: Prioritize adoption barriers
operations.question: Which ordering, onboarding and results-access frictions recur in the evidence?
operations.output: An adoption-barrier brief and research-informed journey recommendations.
operations.validation: Use expert and customer evidence to distinguish process pain points from technical assumptions.

operations.title: Track research delivery and handoffs
operations.question: What evidence or deliverable must be completed before the next product discussion?
operations.output: A delivery and evidence-gap review based on recorded tracker milestones and PMR outputs.
operations.validation: Confirm dates and ownership with the recorded project owner; prioritize the next research handoff.
